name: Data Recipe: PDF inbox to Markdown and AI summary

parameters.content:
## PDF inbox -> Markdown -> AI summary
Drop a PDF (or DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, scan) into a Google Drive folder - or POST a URL to the webhook. [Document to Markdown](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/document-to-markdown) turns it into Markdown (OCR for scanned pages), an LLM summarises it, and a Google Doc with summary + full text lands in your folder.

**Setup (10 min)**
1. Create a Drive folder `PDF inbox` and share it as *Anyone with the link: Viewer* (the Actor downloads by link).
2. *Convert to Markdown*: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
3. Connect Google Drive in the trigger and pick the folder; connect Google Docs in both Docs nodes.
4. Add your OpenAI credential (or swap the model node).
5. Activate. Drive is polled every minute.

Cost: $1.50 per 1,000 pages, +$5 per 1,000 pages that need OCR. Failed files are free.

nodes.name: Convert to Markdown
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/document-to-markdown and returns its dataset. The JSON body is the Actor input - edit it freely.

nodes.name: Create Google Doc
nodes.notes: Pick the folder where summaries should go (default: My Drive root).

actionFields.text:
={{ 'SUMMARY

' + $('Summarize document').item.json.text + '

----------
Source: ' + $('Convert to Markdown').item.json.url + '
Pages: ' + $('Convert to Markdown').item.json.pagesProcessed + ' (OCR: ' + $('Convert to Markdown').item.json.ocrPages + '), words: ' + $('Convert to Markdown').item.json.wordCount + '

FULL TEXT (Markdown)

' + $('Convert to Markdown').item.json.markdown }}
